standard_prerequisites.name: Glue-functors criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the four-step representability template used for the whole proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Right exactness of pullback
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes each chart subfunctor F_i stable under pullback.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjectivity on stalks is open
standard_prerequisites.use: Opens up the chart locus U_i inside S.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces chart membership to surjectivity on the residue fibre.

core_obligations: Define the charts F_i: quotients q with q composed with the coprojection s_i surjective; show F_i is a subfunctor.
Represent F_i: q o s_i is an isomorphism identifying Q with O^{n-k}, leaving k(n-k) free coordinates, so F_i is A^{k(n-k)} over Spec(Z).
Show F_i is contained in F representably by open immersions via the stalk criterion and base change of fibres.
Cover F by the charts: on each residue fibre some coprojection surjects, by dimension counting in vector spaces.
proof_roadmap: Build the chart family, identify each chart with an affine space functor, prove the open-immersion property stalkwise, then cover by rank counting on fibres.
difficulty_reason: Four-step glue-functors verification with a k(n-k)-dimensional affine chart family, Nakayama stalk checks and base-change compatibility of chart membership; every step displayed.
